segments.text: A serious character with a strong sense of justice, Yoshiya is intolerant of irrationality and stupidity.
he is the second Rosei (盧生).
in Bansenjin, Yoshiya (military uniform) is a rosei who have been resolved Amakasu Incident and yoshiya (school uniform) is the fictional character that created by Shizuno
文武共に極めて優秀な本作主人公。

曲がったことや非合理なこと、怠慢その他の締まらない諸々が嫌いで自他共に厳しが、辛辣な言動は冷淡さの表れではなく、困った者を放っておけない面倒見の良さの裏返し。友人一同曰く武士であり、質実剛健な正義の仁。そうした真面目で堅い言動から良家の子息かと思われがちだが、実際は決して裕福と言えない母子家庭育ち。女手一つで育ててくれた母親を敬愛しており、その恩に報いるためにも立身出世して楽をさせてやろうと思っている。
愛読書は南総里見八犬伝。
仁義八行、如是畜生発菩提心に至ると信じる。

友人一同曰く武士であり、質実剛健な正義の仁。
そうした真面目で堅い言動から良家の子息かと思われがちだが、実際は決して裕福と言えない母子家庭育ち。

【能力資質】
全方位、十種隙無しの万能。 あらゆる応用が可能でどんな局面にも対応できるが、本人曰く器用貧乏で裏を返せば個性に欠ける。
しかし、四四八のみ原則として不変なはずの資質適性が変動する可能性を秘めている。
なぜ彼にだけそんなことが出来るのかは不明。
「分からないのはしょうがない。だが分からないから諦めるという怠慢が気に食わん」
She begins attending school with Yoshiya and friends after a two year absence.
Her first meeting with him takes place in the dream world.

She is one of a group of eight childhood friends centering on Yoshiya.
Although her bravado and appearance tend to make her seem like a delinquent, she is a sensible person and a maiden who has been unanimously praised as "the most decent woman" by the men.

She is a stopper and a quieter of the girls who tend to run amok in all sorts of wrong directions, but she is always at a disadvantage because she is outnumbered. Now that Shizuno has joined them, the girls of Senshinkan are no longer in anyone's control.
From Official Website
歩美、栄光と同じ四四八の幼なじみ。
目つきと口の悪さが災いして不良のように思われがちだが、本人にそんなつもりはまったくなく、気風のいい体育会系というだけ。
むしろ仲間内では一番真面目な乙女であり、可愛いものに弱かったりする。
ただし、何をもって可愛いとするかの基準がちょっとおかしい。
座右の銘は一日一善と義を見てせざるは勇なきなり。
四四八と同じ片親で、やはり四四八と同じく親 （晶は父） を深く愛している孝行者。

楯法の “活” と、咒法（じゅほう）の “散”。
仲間全員の回復という非常に重要な資質を持つうえ、戟法の資質も平均レベルには達しているため、自身の打たれ強さと合わせて大抵の危機は自力で対処できる。

She is one of a group of eight childhood friends centering on Yoshiya.

She is a troublemaker among her friends and is usually the one who causes a silly commotion, but because she is unusually smart, she is rarely made to pay the consequences and is usually the only one who gets away with it.
It is clear that the true feeling shared by the group of eight is that someone should take the fall for Ayumi.
From Official Website
晶、栄光と同じ四四八の幼なじみ。
ふわふわとスローモーでマイペースな態度と小柄で可愛い外見からマスコットのような印象を受けるものの、実際のところ仲間内では色物扱い。
有り体に言ってボケ担当だがある種の肝が据わっており、動転することがほぼないためピンチの時は頼りになる奴と皆から一目置かれている。
ただ、結構なゲーオタで、対戦すると容赦なく虐殺してくる点だけはかなり真剣に引かれている。 某FPSの世界上位ランカー。

She is one of a group of eight childhood friends centering on Yoshiya.
The only daughter of a venerable right-wing family, she is a stout girl with high pride and a strong sense of justice. However, she is a disappointing type.

She complains that her character is similar to Yurika's because she is a young lady of good family background, and to Mizuki's because she is a talented literary and martial artist, but everyone around her believes that this will never happen.
Recently, she has been doing more variations of kaogeis.
From Official Website

He is one of a group of eight childhood friends centered around Yoshiya.

He is a typical go-getter with mediocre talent and personality among his friends who are all unique in various ways, but Harumitsu never loses his mediocre sensibility and therefore functions as a mood-maker at the party.

He has been in love with Syouko since he first entered the school, and has repeatedly made advances toward her over the past year, but has yet to receive a favorable response because he has yet to fulfill her condition that he read all of Soseki Natsume's works so that he can memorize them by heart.
From Official Website

「悪いと思ってんならパンツ見せろ」
He is a classmate of Yoshiya, but goes by the name of a loner who doesn't fit in with anyone.

He is a tough-looking loner who doesn't fit in with anyone else, and his reputation among the general student body is not good, but he has actually gotten into a few fights with upperclassmen and other students, so it is not as if he has no roots.
However, it would be a bit harsh to dismiss him as a delinquent, since he has only been able to put out the conflict that his tough appearance has brought about.
Since he is not comfortable with being feared, he has been on friendly terms with Yoshiya for some time now.
From Official Website
四四八のクラスメイトだが、誰とも馴染まない一匹狼として通っている強面。
そのため一般学生の印象は甚だ悪いが、淳士は実際に上級生や他校生との喧嘩沙汰をいくつか起こしているので、根も葉もないというわけではない。とはいえ、それは厳つい外見が招いた火の粉を払ったというだけなので、不良と切って捨てるのは些か乱暴と言えるだろう。変に恐れられるのを鬱陶しがる性格のため、物怖じしない（と言うより尊大な）四四八とは、以前から多少だが口を利いていたようだ。

どちらも偏重した特化型であり、機動力と治癒力は低いものの、膂力と頑強さはズバ抜けている。
そうした特性に加え、咒法を始めとした他の資質はおしなべて低いという尖った性能。 ゆえに完全な白兵、肉弾を突き詰めたスタイルと言える。
「おまえくらいだよ、俺にそんな偉そうな態度でものを言う奴は」

segments.text: The leader of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden. Originally a high-ranking official in Germany, regarded as highly dangerous due to his seemingly boundless talent in all fields. Later, he bowed out of the public eye through the guise of a staged assassination, and formed the Obsidian Round Table alongside Mercurius.

Their subordinate members acted behind the scenes of WW2 and kept on destroying friend and foe alike. His acts of destruction reached their climax during the fall of Berlin. However, he and his three direct subordinates disappeared shortly afterwards, leaving their current whereabouts a mystery.
"You would do well not to disappoint me."
From Dies irae's Kickstarter Campaign Page
聖槍十三騎士団黒円卓第一位“愛すべからざる光（メフィスト・フェレス）”。
黄金の獣と呼ばれるナチスドイツの高官だったが、あまりに有能すぎたために危険視されるようになる。
後、彼は自身が暗殺されたと偽装して闇に潜り、副首領と共に騎士団を結成。
配下の団員達を戦争の裏で暗躍させ、敵といわず味方といわず滅ぼし続け、壊し続ける。
彼の破壊工作はベルリン陥落時に頂点を迎えるが、その後は直属の部下3名と共に消息を絶ち、現在に至るも行方不明。
彼が戻ってきた時に、世界は破滅すると言われている。
圣枪十三骑士団的首领。
本来是德意志的高官，因为过于有才能而被处处提防。
之后，他以被暗杀作为掩护躲了起来，与メルクリウス一起建立了骑士团。
麾下的团员们暗中在战争中活跃，不论敌友一律歼灭破坏。
他的破坏工作在柏林沦陷时迎来顶峰，之后与直属部下3名一起失去了消息，直到现在依旧行踪不明。

She is a mother who loves her only son, Yoshiya, more than anything else.
She is bright, energetic, and unusually young, and although she is even seen as a younger sister rather than a mother, she herself believes herself to be a decent woman full of adult charm.
From Official Website

She is a single PE teacher who has been without a boyfriend for 26 years and is in charge of Yoshiya's class.
She often complains to her colleague, Kurana, about the various problems of the world, but nothing will change unless she learns to be stylish first.
From Official Website

曰く盲打ち。 明らかに行き当たりばったりながら権謀術数を凌駕するため、策士にとっての鬼門めいた賭博師―― と表現できるかもしれない。
【能力資質】
創法の “界”、及び咒法の “射” と “散” を共に極めた最上の空間支配者。
いずれも邯鄲（かんたん）法における上級技、難度が高いとされるものを得手としている点に、狩摩の特殊性が現れている。
また、それと並行して彼は騙まし討ちの名手 （結果的にそうなる） であるため、表面上の戦力はむしろ目くらましであるという可能性も無視は出来ない。
【配下部隊】
大日本帝国神祇省・鬼面衆。
神国・日本の祭祀を司る神祇省。 飛鳥の時代より連綿と続いてきたその組織は明治の初期に消滅したが、裏の実働部隊として闇にあった者たちは生き残った。
それが狩摩の率いる鬼面衆であり、彼らは文字通りの穏（おん）――すなわち鬼の子孫ともいうべき武術・方術・忍術の達人集団に他ならない。
千数百年もの永きに渡って影働きを行ってきた組織のため、首領である狩摩を筆頭に正々堂々という概念は彼らにはなく、その属性は戦士というより殺し屋である。
「分かったら、分際知って亀になっちょれ。 戦真館のヒヨッコども」
in Hachimyojin, he is the first generation of invert cross
and he have the curse from invert cross
in Bansenjin, he is a normal human and didn't have the dream power from invert cross
夢界深層にある何かを巡って争っていると思しき六勢力の一角。逆十字。
紛れもなく四四八の実父だが愛情はなく、息子を駒か何かとしか思っていない向きがある。
極めて冷徹な精神は氷の計算機めいていて、遊びがないため過虐はないが、情けがないため容赦もない。
現在、神野と同盟を組んでいるが、それはあくまで戦略上の判断であり、少なくとも聖十郎に仲間意識は皆無である。
また、六勢力唯一の現代人であるにも関わらず、夢界の時代に違和感なく適応しているなど謎が多い。

端的に、四四八の上位互換。 偽りなく万能な資質を持つため穴が一切存在しない。
同時に、何が得意なのかも分からないため、その固有技がどういうものか想像することも出来ない。
【配下部隊】
不明。 ただし聖十郎にとってすべての他者は道具であるため、配下との間に信頼関係などは皆無であろうと思われる。
「忘れるな。 おまえは俺のために生まれたのだということを」

segments.text: A mocking and ridiculing demon. A curse itself. His greatest desire is to defile, to guide people to the wrong path, the demonic and evil one. But most of his deeds are trivial for him; they are only to shorten his time. He is a proper demon, and tries to grant the wish of the one who summoned him as much as he can, sharing it himself.
Therefore, he is trying to grant the darkest desire of Sera Nobuaki, brother of Sera Mizuki—to defile her to the utmost degree for them to fall into the same Hell together.
As a demon, he does not need to weave his personal dreams to manipulate the world of the collective unconscious, as humans do.
夢界深層にある何かを巡って争っていると思しき六勢力の一角。べんぼう。
無貌、じゅすへる等、数多の名で呼ばれる底知れない男で、道化のように戯れながらすべてを愛で、嘲笑している。
その性質上、積極的に害を加えてくることはなく、場合によっては四四八らの援護もする存在だが、彼の興味は人の憎悪と絶望、それによって生じる混沌を美しく演出することにのみ帰結するので、まともに手を組めるような相手では絶対にない。
一言、悪魔という概念が凝縮したような男である。

一見して相反するその資質が合わさった時、どのような不条理が具現するのかは分からない。
確かなのは、神野に迂闊な攻撃を仕掛けるのは危険極まりないということである。

無し。六勢力唯一の単独行動。
「さんたまりあ うらうらのーべす」
Akira's father is a tough guy who runs a buckwheat noodle shop.
He is a charming and good-natured man with a bold appearance and open-hearted personality, but he is absolutely forbidden to say anything about his head hair.
He is so pathetically depressed when he is confronted about it that he must never say anything about baldness, no matter what happens to him.

He also has a big crush on Eriko, the mother of Yoshiya, which is obvious to everyone, but he thinks he is hiding it well and doesn't have the guts to make a pass at her. He is a cute old man in a roundabout way.
From Official Website
晶の父親で蕎麦屋を営むタフガイ。
まさに豪傑と言える外見と磊落な性格が魅力的な好漢だが、頭髪に関することだけは絶対禁句。そこを突っ込まれると哀れなほど落ち込むため、何があってもハゲなどとは言ってはいけない。

Yurika's butler. Possesses extraordinary fencing skills, but his flawed tea making skills are often the butt of his mistress's jokes. He is extremely popular with women, but his steadfastness and unwavering loyalty to Yurika make him look nigh impregnable.
His hadan makes everything within a specific radius of him light as a feather, allowing him to casually dodge attacks with style as well as easily launch his own.
He is in love with his mistress, Yurika. However, due to his self-loathing as well as other personal circumstances, he was not able to confess his love nor fulfill her dream.

Munefuyu was one of the top students in the first Senshinkan. The horrifying events that marked the academy's downfall traumatized him. As a promise to the friends and classmates he had done awful things to, he gave up on using his left hand in combat.

普段は寡黙だが温厚な従者として主の身の周りを世話しているが、ひとたび命あれば鬼神と化して業火の中に身を投じる。
そのことからも分かるように、彼の忠は疑いようのない確かなものでありつつも、百合香の言うことならばなんでも従うというわけではない。
その基準は彼にしか分からない複雑怪奇なものであるため、四四八らにとっては必ずしも味方と言い切れないところがある。

【能力資質】
力と速さの双方を兼ね備えた稀有なタイプの戟法を操り、同時に解法の透と創法の形も高資質であるため、剣術家として非常に優秀なバランスと言える。
基本は技巧を重視する合理的なタイプだが、必要なら蛮性も発揮できる二面性を有している。
「御意に。 お嬢様」
The current daughter of Tatsumiya House from the past and the great-grandmother of Yurika.
She is the one who ordered Hiiragi Yoshiya and his companions, special students, to stop Amakase Masahiko.
夢界深層にある何かを巡って争っていると思しき六勢力の一角。辰宮。
貴族院男爵家令嬢という、夢界時代における特権階級の人間であり、戦真館（後の千信館）を創立した人物の孫娘にあたる。
そうした背景の影響か、四四八らに対して友好的であり、彼らを庇護するような立場を取る。
大和撫子を地でいく女性で、慎ましく穏やかな態度を崩さないが、真意の見えない面があることは否定できない。

【能力資質】
肉体的には脆弱な非暴力主義者だが他の三資質は極まっており、戦闘力云々という土俵では量れない。
また、神野や狩摩という作中屈指の曲者たちに一目置かれていることからも、夢界における混沌状況の中心人物的な立場を持っているようだ。
【配下部隊】
部隊名無し。
事実上、四四八らの大先輩にあたる戦真館の卒業生と一部在校生で構成された者たち。
戦真館は士官学校であるため通常の学生は将校としての道を歩むのだが、性格や能力が並ではないゆえに扱いかねる危険分子は辰宮家の私兵として配属される。
彼らはそうした意味でも凡百の指揮官に扱える存在ではないのだが、百合香はこの曲者たちから女神のごとく敬われている。
「ありがとう、あなた方はわたくしの誇りです」

Rot Spinne is a member of the Longinus Dreizehn Orden. He occupies the seat number X in the Black Round Table. Mostly known by his Demon Name, as even he does not remember his true name, Spinne's nature is quite different to that of his peers. Instead of direct combat, he specializes in information gathering, black ops, and management. However, given this specialization, he is easily the most cowardly amongst the Longinus Thirteen's ranks.
He is the first and strongest Rosei. He was the first Rosei to conquer the dream world in one cycle by himself.

Masahiko is one who loves people from all his heart, to the extent of madness. Yet he deems people bad at nature and does not unconditionally believe them, like Yoshiya. He intended to make great sacrifices, cause great calamity, and pose as Demon King to inspire their courage and radiance. His ideal world is one of fighting warlords.

Truth be told, he is like a kid who reads books, watches films, and wants to see more and more. At the very end, he was so carried away that he threw away even his goal and was taught back by Hiiragi Yoshiya.

segments.text: A haughty woman with mysterious eyes who leads the Gunmetal Hounds. Prefers using the language of violence with everyone save for her cherished soldiers.
She is one of the three daughters of George Ivanovich Gurdjiev, a Russian-born mystic. Gurdijeva both loathes and respects him.
Her golden mystic eyes have the power to subjugate people.

Her true form is a result of her father's experiments to produce a superhuman. He believed that he could achieve a more developed form of man by connecting body parts of other people to a specific human. This is exactly what he had done by connecting the body parts of Gurdijeva's sisters to her.
She is one of the members of the Tatsumiya noble institute.
Like Munefuyu, she is a current student of Senshinkan who serves as a follower of the Tatsumiya family.
She is ordered by Yurika to support Yoshiya and the others in their efforts to make things easier for them, who in the age of the Dream Realm are considered to be aliens.

On the surface, she is a soft-spoken, gentle woman like her master, but it seems that there is a hint of a salesmile in her personality, and once she gets used to it, she sometimes shows her true colors.
From Official Website
She was a classmate of Yoshiya and his classmates when they entered Senshinkan in dream.

She is a timid person who could not kill an insect and is not the type of person who would be in a military school, but she was admitted to Senshinkan without question as an heir to revive the Hozumi family, which has a long history but has fallen into decline.

All his life he trained his techniques to perfection, reached mastery, yet never once before he fought in battle, never once he killed, never once he fulfilled his purpose, while he began to become old and his body to wilt.
He waited for the day to fulfill his purpose and desires. Therefore, he contracted with Dan Karuma.
And this day has truly come, when he fought to the death against the legions of oni, urged by and feared of great calamity, Nakiri Kuubou, holding pride in defending his country.
His true identity is the old man who has been met by Yoshiya when entering the dream world together with his friends for the first time.
He is a member of the Oni-menshu, subordinates of Karuma, and is particularly skilled in the field of assassination.

He uses an astonishingly gentle style that makes his body seem to have no mass, allowing him to sneak up on his target from behind and take their head without being noticed. His style relies entirely on surprise attacks and deception, making him the perfect embodiment of the Oni-menshu, a group of assassins.

Rinko said that she has similarity with Momo or even the person herself. This fact is rejected by Yasha and said that she is the form of regret from Momo. Under her mask is Hozumi Chihaya (穂積千早); she is Momo's older sister.
A mad dragon. A calamity itself. An evil god of destruction, who once was a good god patronizing people. One who has a man and a woman beginning.
He demands reverence, worship, and sacrifices.
There is no one who can fight him with sheer power, just as a hand strike cannot crush a continent sheet.
Mizuki's younger brother and a student at Senbunkan Gakuen.
In Hachimyoujin...
He was a weak and sickly person who was helped by his sister.

He loved his sister as a woman. At some point of time, he confessed to her, but she told him that "she loves strong men". Therefore, Nobuaki started to try his best to improve himself and become stronger, carving out his attractive points and his true nature. But it had no effect. Dark emotions began to stir in his heart. He became envious of his sister, even becoming tempted to plunge her into the darkness so they could go into Hell together. To not allow himself to actually do this, he committed seppuku. But his despair at the brink of death summoned a demon, Shinno Akikage, who inherited his desire...
